links.surface: عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ

notes: «أَبِي» is the compiler's father, a relation to the compiler, who is not named here; «رَحِمَهُ اَللَّهُ» and «ع» are blessings and are left out
«سَأَلْتُهُ» asks the last-named person; its pronoun is not a link. Offsets are approximate
